jobs.description:
As a Senior Technologist (f/m/div) in our Manufacturing and Operations team at Infineon Technologies Bipolar GmbH & Co. KG, you will work in a high-tech environment where advanced products are created from silicon wafers. In our modern cleanroom environment, every detail matters. With your expertise, you will help shape the future by driving innovation every step of the way.

Your role

- Monitoring, controlling, and initiating manufacturing processes using SPC (Statistical Process Control) methods and process parameters.
- Performing regular cleaning and setup activities on equipment components, including the documentation of all completed work.
- Identifying faults in machines and systems, including taking responsibility for complex repair and maintenance tasks that may not be fully documented.
- Inspecting, servicing, and maintaining production equipment, as well as documenting all related activities.
- Providing on-the-job training and instruction for new employees.
- Coordinating workflows and material flow in a multi-shift operation under cleanroom conditions.
- Setting up machines, loading and monitoring equipment, and actively supporting production operations.

This position is to be filled within a four-shift working model.
Several Senior Technologist (f/m/div) positions are available in the DIF, MET, and PPI departments.

Your profile

You proactively identify opportunities for improvement and efficiency gains and are committed to implementing measures that drive progress. You absorb information quickly, evaluate it from different perspectives based on your extensive experience, and establish new connections and insights. You have the ability to inspire others and motivate them to achieve shared success.

- Successfully completed at least a three-year technical vocational training program, for example as an Electronics Technician or Industrial Mechanic.
- Ideally, you already have initial professional experience in semiconductor manufacturing.
- Good knowledge of MS Office and SAP R/3.
- Strong team-player qualities and proficient German language skills; English language skills are an advantage.
- Willingness to work shifts in a cleanroom environment.

As a Senior Engineer Wafer Processing (f/m/d) in our Research and Development team, you will combine creativity and technical expertise to shape the future of technology, drive pioneering projects forward, and turn innovative ideas into reality.
Are you in?

Your role
As a Senior Engineer Wafer Processing at Infineon Technologies Bipolar GmbH & Co. KG, you will be at the heart of process development and characterization for wafer and chip manufacturing. Your ability to analyze and optimize production processes will be essential in enhancing the performance and quality of our bipolar semiconductor devices. Help create a greener and more livable future for everyone by joining us in pursuing innovative approaches to technology optimization.
Key responsibilities in your new role

- Develop and characterize wafer manufacturing processes with a focus on chemical processes for bipolar semiconductor devices
- Plan and conduct necessary preliminary experiments on individual process parameters using statistical methods such as Design of Experiments (DoE)- Perform chemical experiments in a laboratory environment
- Support the specification of manufacturing equipment, participate in supplier discussions, and contribute to the qualification of equipment for manufacturing processes
- Collaborate closely with manufacturing teams and transfer developed processes to production together with the process team
- Implement measures to increase yield and throughput within the scope of projects

Your profile

You are a quality-conscious and practically minded professional who approaches challenges with strong analytical and solution-oriented thinking. As a team player, you communicate clearly and effectively and are able to build successful working relationships quickly. Your entrepreneurial mindset and structured way of working enable you to turn decisions into action efficiently and to drive ideas consistently through implementation and application. In doing so, you help your team achieve outstanding results.
Qualifications and skills to help you succeed

- A university degree in a scientific or engineering discipline, such as Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, or a related field
- Ideally, initial professional experience in semiconductor manufacturing (frontend) and laboratory environments
- Knowledge of the safe handling of chemicals
- Basic knowledge of semiconductor devices as well as the application of Statistical Process Control (SPC)
- An analytical mindset and excellent German and English language skills

jobs.employer_name: Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
OUR COMPANY

At Boehringer Ingelheim we develop breakthrough therapies and innovative healthcare solutions in areas of unmet medical need for both humans and animals. As a family owned company, we focus on long-term performance. We believe that, if we have talented and ambitious people who are passionate about innovation, there is no limit to what we can achieve; after all, we started with just 28 people. Now, we are powered by 50,000 employees globally who nurture a diverse, collaborative and inclusive culture.

The Position
Are you passionate about innovation, finding cutting-edge solutions and creating value where it matters, around the globe? At the BI global Inflammation team, we strive to deliver innovative Therapeutic and patient centric solutions by putting the patient in the center of everything we do. We foster innovative thinking as well as an agile and collaborative way of working to advance our novel programs and capabilities in Therapeutic Area Inflammation.
The Global TA Inflammation, (Senior) HEOR  Manager, brings technical expertise, driving Outcomes Research (HEOR) and Patient Related Outcomes fostering our patient centric drive. His/she will support the TA Market Access Head by providing oversight, direction, and functional support on HEOR & PRO & Access projects. He/she will be working closely with Value and Evidence Networks within our Global Business Unit and with external stakeholders.
Tasks & responsibilities

- In your new role, you develop and execute on health economics outcomes research (HEOR) & PRO strategies, demonstrating the medical and economic payer-relevant needs to optimize value of BI products.
- In this function, you generate evidence that secures optimal market access, successful HTA assessments, optimal pricing, reimbursement and formulary listing for BI products on a global scale.
- Additionally, you ensure insights to further inform development of the Target Product Profile (TPP), clinical development plan of our pipeline compounds.
- In consideration of regulatory body request and trial development, pre and post launch you will ensure relevant and new patient-reported outcome (PRO) measurement strategies to ensure that the patient perspective is captured in our clinical trial program and interact with regulatory authorities, closely collaborating with other functions.
- Besides, you ensure efficient and timely development of key HEOR deliverables (i.e. payer value stories, payer engagement tools, GVDs, economic models, retrospective database analyses, indirect comparisons, real world evidence data) for assigned BI products.
- Finally, yet importantly, you develop and maintain relevant partnerships with payers, academic research institutions, contract research organizations and other HEOR thought leaders in order to optimize the impact of HEOR & PRO research.

Additional responsibilities as Senior Manager:

- You will define long-term global development strategies for the assets, in close collaboration with the global Marketing and global Medical counterparts, to ensure optimal patient access.
- In addition, you will draft long-term publication strategies, considering the long-term global market development.

Requirements

- Graduate degree, preferably PhD in health economics, Medicine (MD), public health, pharmacy, focusing on Health Technology Assessment, PRO, Pharmacy, Medicine, Public Health
- Several years of pharma industry experience, with positions in areas of relevance for HEOR, PRO consulting or payer authorities
- Multiple years of direct experience undertaking Health Technology Assessments (HTA) & PRO including Evaluations for Regulatory and health authority interventions of pharmaceutical products
- Conducting or being part of a team working on non-interventional studies and RWE programs
- Demonstrated experience of successful regulatory, reimbursement negotiations for launching new products in key markets
- Proven track record of delivering value demonstration materials that resulted in timely patient access and adoption
- Proven ability in appraising clinical evidence (both RCTs and operational evidence)
- Profound knowledge and expertise to formulating COA strategies including validation methods, administration of measures and statistical analyses of COA data
- Excellent communication and influencing skill both in internal and external context

Additional requirements as Senior HEOR Manager:

- Long-term pharma industry experience, with positions in the areas of health economics, pricing & reimbursement, consulting, or payer authorities
- Several years of exposure to international business on a day-to-day basis
- Strong track record in value generation, demonstration and/or communication
- Highly experienced in conducting health economics/outcomes research across multiple specialty disciplines (e.g. patient reported outcomes, health economic modelling, real world data generation)

For employees with a current contract of limited duration, legal / labor agreement requirements for contract extension will be considered.
With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.

Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.

Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.

Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.com﻿
Ready to contact us?
If you have any questions about the job posting or process - please contact our HR Direct Team,
Tel: +49 (0) 6132 77-3330 or per mail: hr.de@boehringer-ingelheim.com
Please submit your application documents in English.

jobs.occupation: Senior HR Specialist - Apprenticeship & Vocational Training (m/f/d) (Ausbildungsberater/in)
jobs.description:
About us The European Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (ESMC) GmbH
is a joint venture between TSMC, Bosch, Infineon, and NXP. For the
first time, TSMC, the global technology leader, is establishing a
semiconductor fabrication plant in the heart of Europe, offering
leading-edge manufacturing technologies for next-generation
semiconductor products. ESMC represents a shared commitment to
strengthening the European semiconductor ecosystem. For our future fab
in Dresden, we are looking for a highly motivated and dedicated:
Senior HR Specialist - Apprenticeship & Vocational Training (m/f/d)
Are you ready to strategically and pedagogically lead the end-to-end
apprentice journey for Europe's newest, most advanced semiconductor
facility? As a Senior HR Specialist - Apprenticeship & Vocational
Training (m/f/d) at ESMC in Dresden, you will move beyond standard
administration to drive collaborative success across all core phases
of our technical vocational education. You will be the architect of
our future talent pipeline— managing employer branding at schools,
coordinating dual-training plans, mentoring Gen-Z apprentices, and
ensuring legal compliance. Fitting into our fast-paced greenfield
environment, this role offers a unique opportunity to shape the next
generation of microtechnology and industrial specialists from the
ground up! Tasks Talent Attraction & Recruitment: Design and execute
targeted school marketing strategies, represent ESMC at career fairs,
manage the applicant pipeline, conduct interviews, and issue
apprenticeship contracts. Onboarding & Pastoral Care: Serve as the
primary point of contact and dedicated mentor for future apprentices,
coordinating orientation phases and providing continuous coaching.
Training Curriculum Coordination: Design dual-training plans, manage
internal rotations across manufacturing departments, and coordinate
closely with local vocational schools (Berufsschulen).
Train-the-Trainer Support: Provide ongoing pedagogical and structured
guidance to our operational Fab trainers on the manufacturing floor.
Legal Compliance: Ensure full operational compliance with the German
Vocational Training Act (BBiG), the Youth Employment Protection Act
(JArbSchG), and other relevant educational laws. Key Stakeholder
Management: Build and maintain excellent collaborative relationships
with the local Works Council (Betriebsrat/JAV), vocational schools,
and local chambers (IHK). Graduation & Placement: Coordinate final
exam preparations, align with department managers to map out
post-graduation career pathways, and handle transition contract
processes. Profile Must-Have: Certifications: Holder of the AdA-Schein
(AEVO / Ausbildereignungsprüfung)—the mandatory qualification to
train apprentices in Germany. Education: Academic degree (B.Sc./M.Sc.)
or certified technical expert background (Staatlich geprüfter
Techniker) with a verified trainer/tester license. Experience: 5+
years of professional experience managing vocational training programs
within a technical, manufacturing, or industrial environment (e.g.,
semiconductor, automotive, automation, or chemical industries).
Regulatory & Institutional Knowledge: Strong, practical experience
working successfully with the IHK and a deep understanding of German
legal frameworks (BBiG, JArbSchG, and BetrVG). Languages: Fluent
German (C1/C2) is mandatory for official communications with
authorities, schools, and parents. Strong English skills (B2/C1) are
required for internal collaboration in our international corporate
environment. Pedagogical Drive: Exceptional communication skills with
the ability to motivate, resolve conflicts, and guide Gen-Z young
adults through their personal and professional development.
Nice-to-Have: Familiarity with cleanroom environments, semiconductor
fab safety regulations, and the technical demands of Microtechnology
(Mikrotechnologe/In). Experience setting up apprenticeship structures
in a fast-growing, ramp-up corporate environment. We offer Security &
Perspective: A permanent employment contract and career advancement
opportunities in one of Europe's leading semiconductors fabs. Company
Pension Plan & Financial Benefits: We support your financial
well-being with our robust company pension plan. As an ESMC employee,
you also benefit directly from TSMC’s performance through an
exclusive Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP). Relocation Support for
Dresden: Moving for us? We’ll provide you with all the support you
will need for your relocation and your start in Dresden. Training &
Development: At the TSMC Newcomer Training Center, gain a deeper
understanding of the processes involved in operating complex
semiconductor equipment through unique hands-on training, while you
continuously expand your knowledge. Health & Well-Being: An annual
budget for your health and well-being (e.g., for sports classes,
massages, or relaxation) helps you stay fit. Meals & Transportation:
Enjoy a daily meal allowance as well as a subsidized public
transportation (e.g., for the Deutschlandticket). Additional contact
details Please apply with your English resume.

jobs.description:

the joint venture between TSMC, Bosch, Infineon and NXP. For the first

committed: Global Procurement Specialist / Strategic Buyer (m/f/d) Are

semiconductor Greenfield project? As a Global Procurement Specialist /
Strategic Buyer, you will take ownership of the commercial end-to-end
sourcing process for critical materials supporting our brand-new
manufacturing site in Dresden. You will negotiate high-volume global
contracts, mitigate supply chain risks, and build resilient

make a global impact. Tasks Strategic Sourcing: Develop, negotiate,
and execute end-to-end global sourcing strategies and contracts to
ensure a highly resilient, cost-effective supply of critical

long-term strategic relationships with a global supplier base to
secure high-quality materials and services. Commercial Negotiation:
Lead commercial negotiations, drive total cost of ownership (TCO)
optimization, and actively manage commercial risks. Performance
Monitoring : Evaluate and manage supplier performance against key
quality, delivery, cost, and risk metrics to ensure full contract
compliance. Risk & Supply Resilience: Proactively identify and resolve
supplier-related issues, including delivery disruptions and quality
deviations, using data-driven preventive actions. Cross-Functional
Alignment: Collaborate closely with engineering, fab operations,
finance, and HQ procurement teams to align sourcing activities with

and scale up supply chain operations. Governance & ESG: Ensure strict
compliance with all internal policies, contractual obligations, trade
laws, and ESG standards across all purchasing activities. Profile
Required: Education: Bachelor’s degree or higher in Supply Chain
Management, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, IT, or a
related field. Experience: Minimum of 4 years of strategic procurement
or supply chain experience within an international industrial setting.
Negotiation Skills: Proven track record in commercial negotiations,
contract management, and strategic supplier evaluation. Languages:
Proficiency in English (C1) and German (C1) is required for seamless
collaboration with local and global stakeholders. Mindset: Strong
analytical thinking, attention to detail in contract review, and the
ability to coordinate multiple complex projects simultaneously.
International Onboarding: Willingness to complete an intensive
training of 3-6 months at TSMC Taiwan. Nice to have: Industry
Knowledge: Prior experience in the semiconductor, chemical, or
advanced materials industry. Certifications: Professional supply chain
or procurement certifications (e.g., APICS CPIM/CSCP, ISM CPSM).
Global Mindset: Experience in collaborating with Asian business
environments; Mandarin language skills are a plus. Why Join ESMC? Help
build a completely new semiconductor manufacturing site in Europe.
Work in a highly international environment with colleagues across the
world. Shape processes instead of maintaining existing structures.
Participate in global projects and cross-functional collaboration.
Additional contact details Please apply with an English resume.

Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

The Clinical Diagnostics Division (CDD) provides innovative diagnostic solutions across selected in vitro diagnostics (IVD) market segments and has been a trusted partner to the IVD industry for more than 40 years.

Our portfolio includes solutions for drugs-of-abuse testing, therapeutic drug monitoring, quality control, sepsis diagnosis, prenatal screening and more. In addition, CDD offers advanced laboratory instrumentation and high-throughput automation solutions for a wide range of clinical laboratory environments.

Our products and solutions are delivered through direct sales, regional distributors and OEM partnerships.

Territory: Eastern & Central Germany
ZIP Codes: 01, 02, 04, 06, 07, 08, 09, 30, 31, 32, 34, 36, 37, 38, 99
Field-based / Remote within the territory

Discover Impactful Work

We are looking for an experienced Account Manager (m/f/d) – Clinical Diagnostics to drive commercial growth across Eastern and Central Germany.

In this field-based role, you will take ownership of a strategically important sales territory, developing existing customer relationships while identifying and winning new business opportunities.

As a trusted advisor to clinical laboratories and healthcare customers, you will combine your scientific understanding with a consultative sales approach to identify customer needs, understand laboratory workflows and develop solutions that deliver measurable value.

You will work closely with customers, key decision-makers and internal cross-functional teams to expand our market presence, increase revenue and strengthen long-term partnerships.

A Day in the Life

- Develop and execute strategic territory and account plans to achieve or exceed annual sales targets
- Take full ownership of revenue growth, pipeline development and commercial performance within the assigned territory
- Manage, develop and grow relationships with existing key accounts
- Identify, qualify and convert new business opportunities within clinical laboratories and other relevant customer segments
- Build strong relationships with laboratory managers, clinicians, procurement teams, technical specialists and other key decision-makers
- Apply a consultative selling approach to understand customer applications, workflows, challenges and future requirements
- Position Thermo Fisher Scientific’s clinical diagnostic solutions effectively and develop compelling value propositions
- Manage the complete sales cycle, from opportunity identification and customer engagement through negotiation and closing
- Collaborate closely with Applications, Technical Service, Marketing, Customer Service and other commercial teams to deliver an outstanding customer experience
- Maintain an accurate and high-quality sales pipeline, forecast and customer data within Salesforce
- Monitor market trends, competitor activities and customer developments to identify new growth opportunities
- Represent Thermo Fisher Scientific at customer meetings, industry events, conferences and exhibitions
- Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction and develop sustainable, long-term business partnerships

Keys to Success

You combine a strong scientific or technical background with commercial drive and a genuine passion for understanding and solving customer challenges.

You are comfortable managing a large territory independently, identifying growth opportunities and engaging with stakeholders at different levels of an organization. At the same time, you enjoy working collaboratively within a global, cross-functional organization.

Education & Experience

- Master’s degree in Life Sciences, Biology, Chemistry, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Medical Technology or another relevant scientific discipline
- Minimum 5 years of successful sales experience, preferably within clinical diagnostics, IVD, laboratory solutions, life sciences, medical technology or healthcare
- Proven track record of achieving or exceeding sales targets and developing a sales territory
- Experience managing complex customer relationships and sales cycles
- Experience working with clinical laboratories, hospitals or other diagnostic customers is highly desirable

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

- Strong technical and scientific understanding, with the ability to quickly understand customer applications and laboratory workflows
- Excellent consultative selling, communication, presentation and negotiation skills
- Strong commercial mindset with the ability to identify and develop new business opportunities
- Demonstrated ability to build trusted, long-term relationships with customers and key decision-makers
- Strong analytical, strategic planning and territory management capabilities
- Results-oriented, proactive and accountable approach to sales
- Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a cross-functional and matrix organization
- Proficiency with CRM systems, preferably Salesforce, and Microsoft Office applications
- Valid driver’s license
- Willingness to travel approximately 50–75% within the assigned territory

Language Requirements

- Fluent German is essential (C1 level or above)
- Strong professional English skills are required for communication within our international organization

Benefits:
We offer competitive remuneration, annual incentive plan bonus, healthcare, and a range of employee benefits. Thermo Fisher Scientific offers employment with an innovative, forward-thinking organization, and outstanding career and development prospects. We offer an exciting company culture that stands for integrity, intensity, involvement, and innovation!

Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Watch (https://jobs.thermofisher.com/global/en/5-reasons-to-work-at-thermo-fisher-scientific)  as our colleagues explain 5 reasons to work with us. As one team of 100,000+ colleagues, we share a common set of values - Integrity, Intensity, Innovation and Involvement - working together to accelerate research, solve complex scientific challenges, drive technological innovation and support patients in need. #StartYourStory at Thermo Fisher Scientific (https://corporate.thermofisher.com/us/en/index.html) , where diverse experiences, backgrounds and perspectives are valued.
